async: An awaited Promise is a blocking Go call that returns the value or error; a rejection is the returned error; undefined is nil or the empty value. A `void | Promise<void>` return is the single Go error.
rationale: OAuthClientProvider is the Go interface OAuthClientProvider (the required members) plus six one- or two-method interfaces for the optional members; the flow type-asserts each optional one, so a provider implements exactly the members it has.

addClientAuthentication.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface ClientAuthenticator (a provider that does not implement it has no hook).

clientInformation.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.ClientInformation; the flow (runFlow) calls it.

clientMetadata.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.ClientMetadata; the flow (runFlow) calls it.

clientMetadataDocument.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface ClientMetadataDocumentProvider.

codeVerifier.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.CodeVerifier; the flow (runFlow) calls it.

discoveryState.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface DiscoveryStateStore, which pairs it with SaveDiscoveryState.

invalidateCredentials.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface CredentialInvalidator; kind is a string.

redirectToAuthorization.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.RedirectToAuthorization; the flow (runFlow) calls it.

redirectUrl.rationale: The property is the Go interface method RedirectURL() string; a URL value is its string form.

saveClientInformation.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface ClientInformationSaver; a provider without it makes a registration fail with `OAuth client information cannot be persisted`.

saveCodeVerifier.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.SaveCodeVerifier; the flow (runFlow) calls it.

saveDiscoveryState.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface DiscoveryStateStore.

saveTokens.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.SaveTokens; the flow (runFlow) calls it.

state.rationale: The optional property is the method of the optional Go interface StateProvider.

tokens.rationale: The property is the Go interface method OAuthClientProvider.Tokens; the flow (runFlow) calls it.
